about:
Killian's Custom Metal Roofing & Panel LLC operates from Des Moines, Iowa, where it was founded in the fall of 2013 by Paula Killian. The venture traces back to the late 1990s when Killian worked at a steel company in Tulsa, Oklahoma, selling coil to roll-former operators. After visiting manufacturing plants, she sought hands-on experience and joined B&M Metals in Murrayville, Georgia, under Chris Bryan, learning panel fabrication and trim production before launching her own operation.

The company manufactures custom-cut, three-foot-wide metal roof panels and matching trim. Its core product line includes Tuff Rib panels rolled from 29-gauge steel with a Sherwin-Williams WeatherX finish that carries a 40-year warranty, available in 22 colors or a Galvalume substrate. It also fabricates standing-seam profiles and distributes commercial architectural systems such as R-Panel, PBR, corrugated, and other wall and roof profiles. In-house capabilities cover panel roll-forming, trim fabrication, and full installation services.

Customers span residential homeowners, agricultural builders erecting pole barns, and commercial contractors specifying architectural wall and roof systems. The firm supplies both direct-to-owner projects and trade accounts needing repair or replacement panels matched to existing profiles.

Killian emphasizes high-quality materials at the lowest practical price, backed by responsive communication—quotes and questions are typically answered the same day—and a standard order turnaround of two to three days.
